verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of SKILL.md instruction files installed into external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. It has no runtime or interface of its own where a built-in assistant could live, so the axis is a category error for this product type. The AI that tasks are delegated to is the host agent, a host-platform capability that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
